Title: Ishaan's Day

Cast

1. Ishaan - 9 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Anjali - 36 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Anil - 44 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
4. Vimla - 63 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses

Places

1. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The bedroom - Day

[Ishaan stands in the bedroom. Anjali and Anil stand near him.]

Anjali: "Today feels like a good day."

[Ishaan stretches his arms above his head.]

Ishaan: "And then?"

[Ishaan sits on the edge of the bed.]

Anjali: "Yes, of course."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Night

[Ishaan stands in the courtyard. Anjali, Anil and Vimla stand near him.]

Anjali: "So, here we are!"

[A full moon shines in the sky.]

Anil (laughing): "That was fun!"

[Fireflies glow in the dark.]

Ishaan (happily): "Exactly right."

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[Ishaan stands in the courtyard. Anjali, Anil and Vimla stand near him.]

Anjali: "What a nice place."

[A dust storm sweeps across the village.]

Anjali: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Flower petals rain down on Ishaan.]

Anil: "Hmm, I see."

[A flock of birds flies across the sky.]

Anjali: "This is amazing!"

Scene 4: The road - Day

[Ishaan stands by the road. Anjali, Anil and Vimla stand near him.]

Anil: "So, here we are!"

[Ishaan rides his bicycle down the road.]

Vimla (gently): "Okay, Anil."

[Ishaan gets into the car.]

Ishaan (happily): "Oh wow!"

[Ishaan gets on the bus.]

Ishaan: "Show me too!"

[Ishaan gets off the school bus.]

Ishaan (softly): "One more time!"

[Ishaan hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Ishaan: "One more time!"

[Ishaan pedals his bicycle hard up the road.]

Ishaan (laughing): "What a day to remember!"
